# Informed Consent — Developer Study on Privacy Captions (TEMPLATE)

**Study title:** Evaluating automatically generated privacy captions for Android apps
**Researcher / contact:** _[name, institution, email]_
**IRB / ethics approval #:** _[fill in before recruiting]_

You are invited to take part in a research study evaluating short, automatically generated
descriptions ("captions") of how Android code uses personal data.

- **What you will do:** review ~15–20 short code snippets, each with one or two candidate
  captions, and rate them on accuracy, clarity, and completeness (≈30 minutes).
- **Voluntary:** participation is voluntary; you may stop at any time without penalty.
- **Data:** your ratings and optional comments are collected pseudonymously (a participant ID).
  No personal data beyond what you choose to provide is collected. Data are stored securely and
  reported only in aggregate.
- **Risks/benefits:** minimal risk; no direct benefit. Findings improve privacy tooling.
- **Compensation:** _[fill in, if any]_.

form, and agree to participate.
